title: python/src/lichen/loadng/messages.py: hop_limit/hop_count not validated on parse
description: Lines 95 and 139: RREQ.from_bytes() and RREP.from_bytes() accept hop_limit/hop_count values 0-255 from wire data, but to_bytes() (lines 74-75, 117-118) rejects values > MAX_HOP_LIMIT (15). A malformed message with hop_limit=255 parses successfully but raises LoadngError on re-serialization, causing asymmetric validation that could crash nodes attempting to forward malformed packets.
close_reason: RREQ/RREP from_bytes now reject hop_limit/hop_count > MAX_HOP_LIMIT (15); hop 0 remains valid. Independent hand-built wire tests: parse 255/16 fail without round-tripping to_bytes. pytest tests/loadng/test_messages.py 19 passed.
